title: pañcasīlāni
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
I undertake the training precept of abstention from
the killing of beings.

I undertake the training precept of abstention from
the taking of what is not given.

I undertake the training precept of abstention from
sexual misconduct.

I undertake the training precept of abstention from
false speech.

I undertake the training precept of abstention from alcohol
and [other] intoxicants which are the basis for negligence.
